interface.signature: def isCircle(N: int, A: List[str]) -> int:

preconditions.description: The input array size N must be between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 20 for s in A)
preconditions.description: Each string in the array A must have a length between 1 and 20 inclusive.
All strings in the array A must consist of lowercase characters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if (len(A) == 0 or all(any(s[0] == t[-1] for s in A) for t in A) and all(any(s[-1] == t[0] for s in A) for t in A)) else 0
postconditions.description: The function returns 1 if and only if the strings in A can be chained to form a circle, meaning every string's first character matches some string's last character and vice versa, ensuring a valid circular chain.
